azure.review.ai_services.audit_logging.title: AI Services configures supported audit logs to a destination
azure.review.ai_services.audit_logging.description: AI Services configures supported audit logs to a destination. Evaluate only complete native ARM configuration for the selected subscription and account.
azure.review.ai_services.audit_logging.remediation: Enable the Audit category or a supported audit/allLogs group in a diagnostic setting. Configure a Log Analytics, Storage, Event Hub or partner destination. Verify ingestion separately.
remediation_steps: Enable the Audit category or a supported audit/allLogs group in a diagnostic setting.
Configure a Log Analytics, Storage, Event Hub or partner destination.
azure.review.ai_services.audit_logging.purpose: Supported Audit category and a configured destination do not establish delivery, retention or sink access.
azure.review.ai_services.audit_logging.missing_observation: Required native configuration could not be completely read and bound to the selected account.
azure.review.ai_services.audit_logging.pass_observation: A diagnostic setting enables supported Audit logs with a destination. Delivery and retention were not tested.
azure.review.ai_services.audit_logging.fail_observation: No diagnostic setting enables supported Audit logs with a destination.

azure.review.ai_services.managed_identit.title: AI Services declares a managed identity
azure.review.ai_services.managed_identit.description: AI Services declares a managed identity. Evaluate only complete native ARM configuration for the selected subscription and account.
azure.review.ai_services.managed_identit.remediation: Enable a system-assigned or user-assigned managed identity. Grant only the roles needed by the workload and review those role assignments separately.
remediation_steps: Enable a system-assigned or user-assigned managed identity.
Grant only the roles needed by the workload and review those role assignments separately.
azure.review.ai_services.managed_identit.purpose: A declared managed identity does not establish least privilege or role assignment safety.
azure.review.ai_services.managed_identit.missing_observation: Required native configuration could not be completely read and bound to the selected account.
azure.review.ai_services.managed_identit.pass_observation: The account declares a supported managed identity type. Role assignments were not assessed.
azure.review.ai_services.managed_identit.fail_observation: The account has no managed identity declaration.

azure.review.ai_services.outbound_restri.title: AI Services declares restricted outbound network access
azure.review.ai_services.outbound_restri.description: AI Services declares restricted outbound network access. Evaluate only complete native ARM configuration for the selected subscription and account.
azure.review.ai_services.outbound_restri.remediation: Enable restrictOutboundNetworkAccess for the supported account. Review allowedFqdnList for necessary destinations and verify workload compatibility.
remediation_steps: Enable restrictOutboundNetworkAccess for the supported account.
Review allowedFqdnList for necessary destinations and verify workload compatibility.
azure.review.ai_services.outbound_restri.purpose: The native outbound restriction flag does not establish allowed-destination safety or tested traffic blocking.
azure.review.ai_services.outbound_restri.missing_observation: Required native configuration could not be completely read and bound to the selected account.
azure.review.ai_services.outbound_restri.pass_observation: The account declares outbound restrictions enabled. Destinations and traffic were not tested.
azure.review.ai_services.outbound_restri.fail_observation: The account declares outbound restrictions disabled.

azure.review.ai_services.prompt_shield.title: Text deployments explicitly configure blocking Prompt Shields
azure.review.ai_services.prompt_shield.description: Text deployments explicitly configure blocking Prompt Shields. Evaluate only complete native ARM configuration for the selected subscription and account.
azure.review.ai_services.prompt_shield.remediation: Assign an explicit RAI policy to each supported text deployment. Enable the Jailbreak filter with source Prompt and blocking true. Review default or unsupported policies manually.
remediation_steps: Assign an explicit RAI policy to each supported text deployment.
Enable the Jailbreak filter with source Prompt and blocking true.
Review default or unsupported policies manually.
azure.review.ai_services.prompt_shield.purpose: Explicit RAI filter configuration does not establish runtime resistance to prompt attacks; default policies are unresolved.
azure.review.ai_services.prompt_shield.missing_observation: Required native configuration could not be completely read and bound to the selected account.
azure.review.ai_services.prompt_shield.pass_observation: Supported text deployments explicitly reference policies with enabled blocking Jailbreak filtering on prompts. Traffic was not tested.
azure.review.ai_services.prompt_shield.fail_observation: A supported text deployment explicitly references a policy without enabled blocking Jailbreak filtering on prompts.
